 Joint extends Asian form with Tokyo quarter-final berth
 Maya Joint
 Tokyo
 WTA
 Cristina Bucsa
 Kamilla Rakhimova
 Maya Joint won through to the quarter-finals of the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo. (James Ross/AAP PHOTOS) 
 Maya Joint has extended her impressive run in Asia, beating Spain's Cristina Bucsa in the round of 16 at the Pac Pacific Open in Tokyo.
 A day after ousting sixth seed Sorana Cirstea, the Australian triumphed 6-1 2-6 6-4 on Wednesday, setting up a quarter-final clash with Uzbekistan's Kamilla Rakhimova.
